blocks.en: Another important selection criterion (whose physical significance is perhaps easier to understand) is the requirement that we accept only \emph{viscosity solutions}.
blocks.zh: 另一条重要的选择准则 (其物理意义也许更容易理解) 是要求只接受\emph{黏性解}.

blocks.en: The reader should be wondering in what sense the limit in \eqref{eq:vanishing-viscosity-solution-definition} is achieved. Well, we\textquotesingle re not going to tell you yet. (All right, if you must know it\textquotesingle s a weak-star limit in $L^\infty$, but we\textquotesingle re not going to explain this terminology until later chapters.) Suffice it to say that if $\bm{u}$ is a piecewise $C^1$ solution containing a single shock, the convergence is uniform off any neighborhood containing the shock.
blocks.zh: 读者想必想知道, \eqref{eq:vanishing-viscosity-solution-definition} 中的极限是在何种意义下达到的. 暂且还不告诉你. (好吧, 如果一定要知道, 它是 $L^\infty$ 中的弱星极限, 但这一术语要到后面的章节才解释.) 这里只需说明: 若 $\bm{u}$ 为含有单个激波的分片 $C^1$ 解, 则在任意包含该激波的邻域之外, 收敛都是一致的.

blocks.en: The rationale behind this choice of a selection criterion is that most conservation laws (again, gas dynamics being the system that we have foremost in mind) are simply approximate mathematical models of physical systems; and the "real" physical systems have some sort of dissipation effects like viscosity that are modeled by the $\bm{A}\bm{u}_{xx}$ term in \eqref{eq:viscous-conservation-law}. Of course, the question immediately comes up, "If \eqref{eq:viscous-conservation-law} is the better model, why are we spending so much time solving the approximate conservation law \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system}?" There are a few different answers to that question.
blocks.zh: 选择这一准则的依据是, 大多数守恒律 (这里首先想到的仍是气体动力学方程组) 只是物理系统的近似数学模型; 而"真实的"物理系统具有某些诸如黏性的耗散效应, 由 \eqref{eq:viscous-conservation-law} 中的 $\bm{A}\bm{u}_{xx}$ 项来描述. 当然, 马上就会产生一个问题: "如果 \eqref{eq:viscous-conservation-law} 是更好的模型, 为什么还花这么多时间求解近似守恒律 \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system}?" 对这个问题有几种不同的回答.

blocks.en: Our next theorem involves the relationship between viscosity solutions and solutions satisfying the entropy condition. Because of the vague nature of our definition of viscosity solutions, we will not be able to give a rigorous proof, but we do supply some formal justification.
blocks.zh: 下一个定理涉及黏性解与满足熵条件的解之间的关系. 由于这里黏性解的定义具有模糊性, 无法给出严格证明, 但会提供一些形式上的论证.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: For a system of conservation laws \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system} for which there exists an entropy/entropy-flux pair $(U,F)$ with convex entropy $U$, any viscosity solution also satisfies the entropy condition.
blocks.zh: 对守恒律方程组 \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system}, 若存在熵/熵通量对 $(U,F)$, 且熵 $U$ 凸, 则任意黏性解也满足熵条件.
blocks.label: thm:viscosity-implies-entropy

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
We present here a plausibility argument rather than a proof. Although the arguments presented here cannot be justified without the tools of distribution theory and $L^p$ spaces, they should give the reader an idea of why the theorem is true. In fact, a reader very familiar with the more advanced topics mentioned above would probably accept the arguments as sufficiently rigorous. For clarity, we consider only the case $\bm{A}=\bm{I}$; the generalization to other positive definite $\bm{A}$ is straightforward.

Multiplying \eqref{eq:viscous-conservation-law} by $\nabla U$ and using \eqref{eq:entropy-flux-pair-definition} we get
\[
\begin{aligned}
U(\bm{u}^\epsilon)_t+F(\bm{u}^\epsilon)_x
&=\nabla U\cdot\bm{u}_t^\epsilon+\nabla U^T\nabla\bm{f}\,\bm{u}_x^\epsilon\\
&=\epsilon\nabla U\cdot\bm{u}_{xx}^\epsilon\\
&=\epsilon(U_{xx}-(\bm{u}_x^\epsilon)^T\nabla^2U\bm{u}_x^\epsilon)
\end{aligned}
\]
Using the convexity of $U$ (which implies the positive definiteness of the Hessian matrix $\nabla^2U$) we obtain
\begin{equation}\label{eq:viscous-entropy-differential-inequality}
U_t+F_x\leq\epsilon U_{xx}.
\end{equation}
The right-hand side goes to $0$ (in the sense of distributions) as $\epsilon\to0$, so we have \eqref{eq:entropy-distribution-inequality}.
blocks.zh:
这里给出的是合理性论证, 而非证明. 虽然没有分布理论与 $L^p$ 空间的工具就无法使这里的论证严格化, 但它们应能让读者了解这一定理为何成立. 事实上, 非常熟悉上述较高深主题的读者, 可能会认为这些论证已经足够严格. 为清楚起见, 只考虑 $\bm{A}=\bm{I}$ 的情形; 推广到其他正定 $\bm{A}$ 是直接的.

将 \eqref{eq:viscous-conservation-law} 乘以 $\nabla U$, 并利用 \eqref{eq:entropy-flux-pair-definition}, 得到
\[
\begin{aligned}
U(\bm{u}^\epsilon)_t+F(\bm{u}^\epsilon)_x
&=\nabla U\cdot\bm{u}_t^\epsilon+\nabla U^T\nabla\bm{f}\,\bm{u}_x^\epsilon\\
&=\epsilon\nabla U\cdot\bm{u}_{xx}^\epsilon\\
&=\epsilon(U_{xx}-(\bm{u}_x^\epsilon)^T\nabla^2U\bm{u}_x^\epsilon)
\end{aligned}
\]
利用 $U$ 的凸性 (它蕴含 Hessian 矩阵 $\nabla^2U$ 的正定性), 得到
\begin{equation}\label{eq:viscous-entropy-differential-inequality}
U_t+F_x\leq\epsilon U_{xx}.
\end{equation}
当 $\epsilon\to0$ 时, 右端在分布意义下趋于 $0$, 因而得到 \eqref{eq:entropy-distribution-inequality}.
